messages:
elena: FYI we got a flood of SAST hits after yesterday's RBAC change that granted the ci-keystore-reader SA access. ~130 findings in infra repo, many look like the new sealed-secret encoding. Can we quickly triage?
max: Which patterns are firing? Any sample?
elena: Example from the run (sanitized):
```
FILE: infra/helm/values.yaml:74
FINDING: potential-aws-credential
MATCH: AKIAEXAMPLE1234567890
CONTEXT: value = 'sealed:v3:AKIAEXAMPLE1234567890'
```
arjun: Got it. The scanner regex sees the AKIA prefix and marks it. sealed:v3 changed the token layout. This is a detector/context issue.
scanner-bot: scan id=209112 uploaded. Report: https://scans.internal/209112 (redacted). Attached: hit-sample.csv. Reaction :robot_face:.
qa-ops: Short-term plan: 1) collect sample hits + manifests; 2) run KMS decrypt audit for principal svc-ci-keystore during the CI window (2026-03-23T15:40Z -> 15:55Z); 3) open a scoped suppression with TTL; 4) patch regex and unit tests.
elena: I'm ok with that. We need the KMS audit before we suppress. Who can run the query?
arjun: I can. Will pull decrypt events and include request IDs.
max: For suppression PR, let's scope to infra/** and ruleset-v3 and set expiry to 72h. Include evidence tar and approver tag. Scanner config repo has a suppression-template that autopopulates those fields.
qa-ops: Also suggest a temporary internal label on findings: reason=sealed-encoding to help analysts filter while we fix rules.
arjun: Proposed regex tweak: `(?<!sealed:v3:)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b` — negative lookbehind for the sealed prefix. We'll add unit tests that include sealed:v2/v3 samples and a corpus of real keys to ensure no regression.
elena: Good. Please also add a guard in detector logic: if value contains 'sealed:' treat as low confidence unless context shows clear text. That helps stop similar prefixes for other clouds.
scanner-bot: suppression PR template: author=@max, justification="sealed:v* encoding causing false positives after keystore RBAC change", expires=72h, evidence_url=https://tickets.internal/SEC-1355/ev.tar.gz.
arjun: KMS audit query result: no Decrypt events for svc-ci-keystore in 15:40-15:55Z. Attached audit snippet in SEC-1355. No cleartext surfaced.
max: Opening suppression PR: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/527 — includes evidence and audit link. Approver requested: @elena.
elena: Approving suppression after seeing audit. Approve now.
qa-ops: After applying the regex patch locally, noisy hits dropped from 130 -> 4. Manual review shows 4 are legitimate creds. Next: apply ruleset-v4 candidate and remove suppression once merged.
arjun: Filed follow-up issue to harden detector logic: https://git.internal/scanner/issue/7921 (ops: ignore-sealed-encodings).
elena: Also please add a one-liner to the incident runbook: "When RBAC/keystore changes precede scan spikes, check sealed-secret encodings and KMS decrypt audit before escalating."
max: Done, pushed runbook change to docs/playbooks/sdlc-scans.md and added cross-ref to SEC-1355.
elena: Thanks all. Closing when ruleset-v4 lands and suppression is revoked. :white_check_mark:
